checks.name: Add buttons open local creation rows and cancellation leaves all data untouched
App button creates one app, its default profile and first empty variable
Profile button creates an appended profile with one selected variable
Variable button appends a mkVar-shaped variable and selects it
Blank names, reserved profile name, invalid scope and invalid mode reject atomically
Duplicate app/profile and same-scope variable names reject without partial children
Matching names may coexist in User and System and export as a V2 two-record array
Existing Special target passes special=true and replace into a new profile
Diff records app and profile subtree additions once and variable addition once
Restore removes all added levels, preserves original object/runtime identity and environment
New app is reachable in workbench and preview without writing simulated Windows/history
Restoring a selected new app leaves config and workbench navigation usable
Existing invalid choice blocks any new entry without mutating the draft
Failed and cancelled creation never add configuration nodes or diffs
Same variable name in System requires an explicit scope choice and commits once
Whole target creation constrains the UI mode to replace and preserves the inherited rule
Candidate draft rejects blank or duplicate label and duplicate full value before writing
Candidate draft cancellation and composition keys preserve model and focus
Candidate draft keeps leading newline, spaces and empty elements after view and variable switches
All-profiles variable entry creates under its own group
Grouped entry works when the target profile has fewer or no variables than the current index
Creation entries switch directly and restore drafts at their original owners without conflict prompts
Choice and application drafts switch without prompts; successful choice creation keeps the other draft
Restore and global reset clear pending creation without manufacturing a diff
Composing Enter and Escape leave the name draft alone; plain Escape restores entry focus
A new same-target selection invalidates and refreshes the open shared-target preview
A name-only profile is a resumable empty session draft outside configuration and export
Cancelling a first variable returns to its named container; discard and restore clear only session drafts
Name-only app and profile stages survive navigation without creating a placeholder variable
Named container stages reject invalid names and final validation failures without losing their owner
Variable creation requires only its name; optional properties stay collapsed and default values edit after creation
App/profile name panels stay beside their entries and the current variable remains editable
The first profile of a named app opens at the profile entry without moving its form to the canvas
The add-variable entry and name field occupy the last slot in the same variable strip
Config creation and rendering produce no JSDOM runtime errors
